# ssh-wrapper

Canonical documentation: https://kogeler.github.io/ssh-wrapper/
Source: https://github.com/kogeler/ssh-wrapper

ssh-wrapper is a typed, standard-library-only CPython 3.13 and 3.14 library for
Linux that owns one native OpenSSH ControlMaster, constructs mux-only secondary
channels, and can heartbeat-supervise one owned remote process group.

Start with:
- /ssh-wrapper/user/installation/
- /ssh-wrapper/user/usage/
- /ssh-wrapper/user/api/
- /ssh-wrapper/user/security/
